name: Lamosa
summary: Cool grey SaaS-studio site built from white cards nested in darker grey trays, bold tight Satoshi headlines, black pill buttons with a white arrow knob, and a coral red used only as tiny section markers and badges.

fonts.pairing: Satoshi 700 at -0.05em for compact two-line headlines, Inter 500 for all body and UI text in mid grey

signature: centered headline flanked by two drifting columns of tilted, fading quote cards
every section opens with a tiny coral square above a centered two-line heading
grey 32px-radius tray holding white 24px cards, with one card per tray inverted to near-black
black pill buttons with a separate white circular arrow knob inside
faint dashed vertical guide lines framing the 1136px content column
imagery: dark moody product renders and devices on black, phone mockups, small square client avatars; mostly UI and icon driven
layout_grid: 1136px content column inside dashed guides, roughly 100px between sections, 3-column card trays, 2-column project and testimonial grids
